faq.title: Billing questions
faq.a1: No. Every pass is a one-time payment. Nothing renews automatically, so there's nothing to cancel.
faq.q2: What happens when my pass ends?
faq.a2: You keep your account, saved researchers and tracker. You simply go back to the free allowance.
faq.q3: Do I need a pass to search or apply?
faq.a3: No. Searching for researchers, browsing positions and applying are always free.
faq.a4: No. Verified professors post positions, share research and find students for free.
faq.q5: Who do I contact about billing?
faq.a5: Use the contact page and we'll get back to you.
